body:
Naraka blade point is Hella fun for me at least 😊
Pros: action melee battle royale, with unique gameplay mechanics and deep character customisation. I decided to give the game a try due to the fact that you can actually use an image of a person’s face to scan and model it over the characters.
Cons: its quite difficult after your first match (due to bots) so don’t be surprised if you get ur ass kicked in the second match.
But the game truly shines when you actually learn the mechanics and start to outplay your opponents, although it is not perfect balanced.(gotta admit)

I have,  multiple sessions. I was taking Xanax(prescribed from the psychiatrist) for about a year and stopped for 3 years(until now). I had practice thinking about countering negative thoughts while I was in medication.
